_comment: Tier-2: DISPLACEMENT is the structural DOF; ROTATION must be added additionally for beams and shells. Pitfall (kratos.linear_elasticity #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The claim's precise part is verified: creating CrBeamElement3D2N with only DISPLACEMENT added succeeds AND elem.Initialize(ProcessInfo) does NOT raise; the failure appears only at the first GetSolutionStepValue(ROTATION_X), as RuntimeError 'This container only can store the variables specified in its variables list. The variables list doesn't have this variable:ROTATION_X'. Adding ROTATION makes the same read return 0.0. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
